results.expected: An unsent draft resumes without any write and remains distinct from observed server values
A pending operation resumes by its original operation ID without a new mutation
A known account mismatch neither queries nor displays another account task data
Expired authentication preserves the intent internally and queries it after validated same-account reauthentication
Successful reauthentication does not imply write permission
Server precondition mismatch preserves the newer server state and entered draft
Refreshing server facts does not silently authorize overwriting the refreshed revision
A late older read cannot overwrite a more recent accepted read; opaque tags are not ordered
An old-account response cannot repopulate the view after account switching
A missing or expired operation record stays unresolved and never triggers a fresh operation automatically
Confirmed operation result and subsequently observed resource state remain distinct
Failure to read the current resource does not erase a separately verified operation success
After explicit current review, a valid conditional edit changes the intended resource once

limits: Trusted session/capability fixture only; no real authentication, authorization or secure storage assessment.
Opaque tags are compared by equality; this is not a production HTTP implementation.
No browser, assistive technology or human efficacy evidence.
